notes.title: Online multiplayer for Lighthockey
notes.content: We finally added multiplayer support. If other players are online you can use the new menu in the top left corner to challenge them. We might add a leaderboard later.

notes.title: Lighthockey update
notes.content:
We improved the menu screens. Game modes are now easier to understand, and everything looks nicer.
The bot AI has also been tweaked. Bots are a bit stronger now, especially at lower ranks.
